integrity_notes: Exact polynomial and finite-subset arithmetic are reproducible using the included standard-library checker. The published general variance formula and independent-survival results are acknowledged. No independent scientific audit or independent bibliographic certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only rooted, strictly positive, fully binary ultrametric trees with one equally likely mark per tip and uniformly chosen fixed-size without-replacement subsets. The statement is a five-tip topology and branch-parameter phase classification, not a novel variance formula or a universal large-tree assertion.
title: Five tips and a \(2+3\) root split are sharp for double-peaked phylogenetic rarefaction variance
